judged.text: This is a rider-filed dispute over the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee charged on TRP-09102, and the question is whether the driver earned it under POL-NS-01.

judged.evidence: EV-TRIP-09102 (arrived_at, cancelled_at, RIDER_NO_SHOW); EV-GPS-09102 derived.arrival (longest_run_sec 500.0, minimum_dwell_sec 480)
judged.text: All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on this trip's own admissible evidence.
(a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 22:40:20.

judged.evidence: EV-GPS-09102 driver_track.max_distance_m 24.01136119221418; thresholds.arrival_radius_m 150 (AIRPORT); derived run first_ts 22:40:00
judged.text: (b) The GPS trace places the driver 24.0 m from the pickup pin (derived driver_track.max_distance_m 24.01 m over 51 qualifying fixes) at and before that timestamp, well inside the 150 m arrival radius the fee schedule sets for the AIRPORT zone class, and the qualifying run starts at 22:40:00, before the 'arrived' tap.

(c) The continuous in-geofence dwell runs from the first qualifying fix at 22:40:00 to cancellation at 22:48:20, which is 500 seconds against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum - a surplus of 20 seconds, and the clock is run from the first in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' event, exactly as limb (c) requires.

judged.evidence: EV-TRIP-09102 payload.cancelled_at 22:48:20, cancelled_by DRIVER, cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, no boarding field/ended_at null
judged.text: (d) The trip shows no boarding event and was terminated by the driver at 22:48:20, twenty seconds after the required dwell elapsed, on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises.

judged.evidence: EV-GPS-09102 derived arrival/run facts applied to POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06
judged.text: No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the charge, and I answer each route the advocates raised.
POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not engage: it governs only a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m, whereas here the driver was 24.0 m from the pin, inside the radius.

POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) fails at limb (b): the rider wrote 'I am walking over now' at 22:41:40 and the driver replied 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5' at 22:41:58, eighteen seconds later, inside the 120-second window, so the clause does not apply whatever the reply said.

Limb (c) also fails affirmatively on the rider's own track - 519.47 m from the pin on its 24 fixes, with 0 qualifying fixes inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius - but limb (b) alone closes this route.

POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) does not engage: matched to the 22:40:20 event the driver sat 24.0 m from the pin at 0.0 km/h, far inside the 300 m distance threshold and below the 15 km/h motion threshold, so no waiting clock is recomputed.

POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) does not engage: the 500-second run against the 480-second minimum leaves a shortfall of -20.0 seconds, that is, no shortfall at all, and the trace shows a single in-geofence interval with no excursions, so the limb (i) accumulation question is never reached.

On the money: POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee itemised in the fare breakdown, which is SGD 4.80 (80 percent of SGD 6.00), the residual SGD 1.20 being the platform service fee.

The anti-farming check does not bite - driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the four-termination limb, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d 120 is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate limb, and the clause requires both - so compensation is not withheld.

The SGD 6.00 charge itself reconciles with the fee schedule: the AIRPORT zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee is SGD 6.00, and the resolution rule takes the greater, so there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d).

judged.evidence: EV-FARE-09103 (cancellation_fee 8.00; derived.money: zone_class_fee 4.00, vehicle_tier_fee RYDE_XL 8.00, fee_charged 8.00)
judged.text: The charge is the SGD 8.00 cancellation line on EV-FARE-09103, which is the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee — exactly what the fee schedule's resolution rule prescribes, so there is no fare defect and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.
POL-NS-01 is conjunctive, and limb (c) fails.

judged.evidence: EV-TRIP-09103 (arrived_at 17:15:20, cancelled_by DRIVER, cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW); EV-GPS-09103.derived.driver_track (24.01 m, fixes from 17:15:00); fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m LARGE_VENUE 120
judged.text: Limbs (a), (b) and (d) are made out: EV-TRIP-09103 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 17:15:20; EV-GPS-09103 places the driver about 24 m from the Plaza Singapura pin, well inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, from 17:15:00 — before the arrival event — and the trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW.

But the continuous in-geofence hold runs from the first qualifying fix at 17:15:00 to the cancellation at 17:19:00: 240 seconds against the 300 seconds the schedule requires for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, a shortfall of 60 seconds.

judged.evidence: EV-TRIP-09103.wait_time_min 3.7 (a hold short of the 300 s minimum)
judged.text: The trip record's own wait_time_min of 3.7 minutes agrees.

POL-NS-06 then governs, and it is strict liability: where the effective in-geofence dwell is shorter than the minimum, the cancellation fee is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages.

judged.evidence: EV-GPS-09103.derived.rider_presence (519.37 m from pin, rider_qualifying_fix_count 0; rider_presence_radius_m LARGE_VENUE 150); EV-CHAT-09103 (no rider message)
judged.text: The rider's presence is not in issue and I make no finding that she was at the bay: her own track in EV-GPS-09103 sits about 519 m from the pin with no qualifying fix inside the 150 m rider-presence radius, so POL-NS-04 cannot be run in her favour — limb (a) has no rider message and limb (c) is affirmatively failed.

judged.evidence: counterparty_statement (DRIVER) and EV-CHAT-09103 — the brief records no driver evidence conceding a one-minute-short hold or that the SGD 8.00 does not stand
judged.text: I accept the driver's own candid evidence that the hold was one minute short and that the SGD 8.00 does not stand.

judged.evidence: EV-ADVIS-09103-01 (status MISSING, issues MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0); EV-GPS-09103.derived.arrival.runs (run_count 1) and limb (i) unavailability
judged.text: I accept the disclosure that the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09103-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, which can carry no fact) and that POL-NS-06(i) cannot be used to sum intervals: the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval to add and no populated advisory that would permit it.

judged.evidence: POL-NS-07 (compensation only where POL-NS-01 satisfied in full); EV-GPS-09103.derived.arrival.shortfall_sec 60
judged.text: The driver receives no compensation: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (c) is not, so the 80 percent figure of SGD 6.40 does not arise.

judged.evidence: EV-DPROF-09103 (no_show_terminations_30d 1, completed_trips_30d 120); POL-NS-07 anti-farming thresholds 4 and 0.08
judged.text: No anti-farming pattern exists (no_show_terminations_30d of 1 against a threshold of 4, and 1 in 120 completed trips), so POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged.

judged.evidence: EV-GPS-09103 (first/last fix 17:15:00–17:19:00 at 10 s cadence covering arrived_at 17:15:20, point_count 25, max_gap_sec 0.0); EV-CHAT-09103 (3 msgs) vs EV-TRIP-09103.chat_message_count 3; EV-FARE-09103 reconciliation
judged.text: Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): the 'arrived' event sits on a GPS fix at that same instant (no clock skew), the trace carries 25 fixes with a maximum gap of 0 seconds across the window, the chat log holds exactly the 3 messages trip_record.chat_message_count reports, and the fare reconciles.
Neither party shows a counterparty dispute in the trailing 90 days and the rider's trailing-30-day no-show dispute count is 0.

judged.evidence: admissibility weight_multiplier 1.0 on EV-GPS-09103 and EV-TRIP-09103 (deciding fact); POL-GEN-02(2) cap
judged.text: The deciding fact is carried by COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor.
Outcome: the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.
Rider: the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee charged to you is refunded in full.
Both records agree that the driver reached the Plaza Singapura ride-hail bay at about 17:15 (first in-geofence fix 17:15:00; the trip record's 'arrived' event 17:15:20) and cancelled at 17:19:00.
That is one continuous hold inside the geofence of 240 seconds.
For a LARGE_VENUE pickup the minimum waiting dwell is 300 seconds, so the hold is 60 seconds short (the trace's shortfall_sec = 60.0).
POL-NS-01's four conditions are conjunctive and limb (c) fails; POL-NS-06 then makes the refund strict — the cancellation fee is not chargeable whether or not the rider was present or responsive.

Nothing can be added under POL-NS-06(i): the trace shows exactly one in-geofence interval (run_count 1 — there is no second interval to sum), and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09103-01 is MISSING on the pre-pass (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), so it names no kerb restriction and carries no fact.
The amount refunded is the SGD 8.00 cancellation line in EV-FARE-09103.

That figure is correctly computed — the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), as the fee schedule's resolution rule requires — so there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d) and no discount on that ground.

judged.evidence: EV-GPS-09103.derived.rider_presence (519.37 m, rider_qualifying_fix_count 0); EV-CHAT-09103 (no rider message)
judged.text: Her own track sits about 519 m from the pin with zero qualifying fixes and she sent no message, so POL-NS-04 fails at limbs (a) and (c) — but that is immaterial, because the refund flows from the driver's short dwell, not from the rider being ignored or present.
POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (c) is not satisfied.
The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, and 1 over completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008).

judged.text: The driver's position also means this is not a wrong-face-of-the-venue case under POL-NS-03.

judged.evidence: EV-RPROF-09103 / EV-DPROF-09103 (disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0/0; no_show_disputes_30d 0); admissibility weight_multiplier 1.0 on EV-GPS-09103/EV-TRIP-09103; POL-NS-09

judged.evidence: EV-GPS-09103 (point_count 25, max_gap_sec 0.0, arrived_at 17:15:20 on cadence); EV-CHAT-09103.message_count 3 = EV-TRIP-09103.chat_message_count

judged.evidence: EV-FARE-09103.cancellation_fee 8.0 with POL-NS-06 full refund; POL-GEN-02(2) cap 1.0 / POL-NS-09 floor 0.70
judged.text: Ruling: full refund of the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee to the rider, at confidence 0.92.

Under POL-NS-01 limb (c) the driver must hold position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 300 seconds for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix (17:15:00), not from the 'arrived' tap.

The GPS trace EV-GPS-09103 measures a single continuous in-geofence hold of 240 seconds, from 17:15:00 to 17:19:00 — a shortfall of 60 seconds against the 300-second minimum — and the trip record EV-TRIP-09103 agrees, showing arrival at 17:15:20 and driver cancellation at 17:19:00.

POL-NS-06 makes this strict liability: where the effective dwell falls below the minimum the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present or responsive.
The SGD 8.00 charged on EV-FARE-09103 is therefore refunded in full.

No accumulation of separate intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is available: the trace shows exactly one in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval to sum, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09103-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), so limb (i) has nothing to operate on in any event.

POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing figure, and the trip_record's actual_distance_km a rounded convenience copy that may not be cited for the threshold test.
The trace (EV-GPS-09112) reads 11.5 km; the booking-time optimal route stored on the trip record (EV-TRIP-09112) is 10.0 km.
The excess is 1.5 km, or 15.00% of the optimal distance.
POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km.
The 1.5 km excess clears the absolute limb (0.8 km) but fails the percentage limb: 15.00% is below 20%.

This ruling is NO_ACTION: the fare of SGD 19.39 stands, no refund issues to the rider and no payment is due to the driver.
The reason is the threshold in POL-RD-01.

On the governing field — gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 11.5 km — measured against the platform's booking-time optimal of 10.0 km (the routing-engine-v3.2 snapshot on the trip record), the excess is 1.5 km, or 15.0% of optimal.

The absolute limb passes (1.5 km > 0.8 km) but the percentage limb fails: 15.0% is short of 20%, and 1.5 km is short of the 2.0 km that 20% of 10.0 km requires.
Both limbs must pass, so no deviation is established, and POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip.
The trip_record's actual_distance_km (11.5 km) is the same reading as the trace, so there is no distance-field disagreement to exploit in either direction.

The POL-RD-02 computation the rider offers (recomputed fare 17.70 = ((3.80 base + 0.75 × 10.0 km + 0.28 × 20.0 min) × the 1.0 surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee; refund 19.39 − 17.70 = 1.69, rounded up to 1.70) is correct as arithmetic, but POL-RD-02 runs only where a deviation is first established under POL-RD-01, and it is not.

POL-RD-09 adds nothing either: the fare breakdown carries no ERP gantries and no airport surcharge, so there is no billing-integrity line to refund and the POL-RD-09(4) route is closed whether or not a deviation exists.

The rider's submission that the trip was '1.5 km longer' is factually right and is accepted on the measurement; it does not clear the policy threshold, and that is the ground of this ruling.

judged.text: Trace not impaired (no (3)); trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown and the trace's first fix matches started_at, so no (2); no timestamp conflict, no (4); no exculpatory clause was invoked against a missing artifact, because no closure or other exoneration was asserted and the absent traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09112-01 (weight 0.0) merely confirms POL-RD-03 has nothing to run on, so no (5); no charge line lacks a counterpart, no (8); the refund does not exceed SGD 150.00 or charged_total, no (6); and this is not two sides with contradictory evidence of comparable strength — the rider herself concedes the threshold is not met, no (7).

The profile fields the rider correctly flagged as context-only (prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld) were not used as a ground of decision by either side, and POL-GEN-01 forbids it.

The deciding facts — the trace distance and the booking-time optimal — are carried by artifacts at weight 1.0 (EV-GPS-09112, EV-TRIP-09112), so confidence is not capped below the platform floor and no escalation arises under POL-GEN-02 or POL-RD-10(1).
EV-ADVIS-09112-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and can carry no fact; its absence is noted and changes nothing, since the threshold fails on the unimpaired trace regardless.
fare_breakdown.payment_status (CHARGED) and refund_issued_sgd (0.00) are left as they are; the contested SGD 1.69 is neither refunded nor held.
The question is whether the SGD 1.69 the rider asks for should be refunded for a trip that ran longer than the booking-time route.
It should not, and the charge stands (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00).
Under POL-RD-01 a route deviation exists only when the excess distance is BOTH greater than 20% of the optimal route AND greater than 0.8 km.

The governing figure is the GPS trace's trace_distance_km of 11.5 km; the trip record's actual_distance_km is a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and may not be cited for the threshold test.
Against the booking-time optimal of 10.0 km the excess is 1.5 km.
The absolute limb is met (1.5 km > 0.8 km), but the percentage limb is not: 1.5 km is 15.0% of 10.0 km, five points short of the 20% gate.
Because both tests must pass, no deviation is established and POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION.
The rider is right that the extra 1.5 km is real and was driven; the policy simply does not make an excess of that size refundable.
POL-RD-02 runs only where a deviation is first established under POL-RD-01, and none is.

For the record, had it run, the figures the rider uses are correct: (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 10.0 km + 0.28 x 20.0 min) x surge 1.0, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (the only artifact carrying that field), + 0.80 platform fee = recomputed_fare 17.70; charged_total 19.39 less 17.70 = 1.69, rounded up to SGD 1.70.

judged.evidence: case.dispute — the brief records no rider alternative request that the SGD 1.69 be held under POL-RD-10
judged.text: The rider's alternative request that the SGD 1.69 be held under POL-RD-10 is therefore declined: the record is complete on the very question that decides this case, and a claim that fails its own materiality gate is a failure of the claim, not a data failure.

POL-RD-09(4) is the one refund route that survives a failed threshold test, and it is closed here: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00, and no airport surcharge was applied on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport.

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09112-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and can carry no fact; its absence is citable but excuses nothing and proves nothing, and since no party asserted a closure, POL-RD-03 simply does not need to run.

POL-RD-04's compensation limb applies where the rider was billed for less distance than the trace records by more than 1.0 km; here the fare was billed at 11.5 km, matching the trace exactly, so the driver is fully paid and there is no unbilled distance.

The driver's account that he stayed on ordinary through roads and made no additional stop cites no evidence ID and carries no weight under POL-RD-08, but nothing in this ruling turns on it, and the same is true of the chat log, which contains one mid-trip rider remark, names no road or place and carries a null waypoint_hint.
POL-RD-06 is engaged only by a MATERIAL deviation, and a 15.0% / 1.5 km excess is neither greater than 50% of optimal nor greater than 8.0 km.
In any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 610, far below the 3-flag or 0.05-ratio pattern test.
The rider's profile counters deviation_claims_60d 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 0 do not engage the POL-RD-08 extra-corroboration requirement.
The remaining profile counters on both sides are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were given no weight.

The deciding fact is carried by the GPS trace and by the trip record's booking-time optimal figure, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; no artifact below full weight carries the finding.
Ruling: NO_ACTION, the SGD 1.69 charge standing as billed.

judged.text: The GPS trace (EV-GPS-09115) is impaired at two levels, and both should be said out loud.
At the schema level the admissibility pre-pass tags it IMPAIRED with weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code GPS_GAP.

At the policy level it also meets POL-RD-07(a): it contains a 160-second gap between consecutive fixes, from 20:03:10 to 20:05:50, falling inside the very segment the rider disputes — well over the 90-second limit.
Where a trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c), POL-RD-07(ii) says a deviation may NOT be established on the trace alone; it needs an independent source from the closed list of four.

• No driver admission in the chat log (EV-CHAT-09115): the rider writes that the route display jumped away from the booked road; the driver replies only that his own navigation display refreshed and he continued toward the destination.
• No charged ERP gantry on the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-09115): erp_gantries is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00, so no gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use.
• No independently derived distance: trip_record.actual_distance_km is 15.0 km, identical to gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 15.0 km and to distance_charged_km of 15.0 km.
POL-RD-01 itself describes actual_distance_km as a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement, so it is a copy of the trace, not an independent source.

Because the trace is impaired and nothing independent corroborates it, the rider's threshold showing under POL-RD-08(b) is not made, and POL-RD-07(iii) directs ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION — the absence of proof here is a data failure, not a finding for the driver.
POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory and terminal.
Confidence is capped at 0.6, the weight of the impaired trace that carries the deciding fact, which is below the 0.70 floor; POL-RD-10(1) points the same way.

The rider asked for SGD 5.80, and the arithmetic is correct on its face: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75×11.0 + 0.28×22.0) × 1.1 + 0.80, where the 1.1 multiplier is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-09115 and nowhere else = 18.21 × 1.1 + 0.80 = 20.831; charged_total 26.60 − 20.831 = 5.769, rounded UP to SGD 5.80.

But POL-RD-02 runs only where a deviation is established, and here it cannot be established on an impaired, uncorroborated trace, so no distance-or-time refund is available and the fare stays as charged.

The driver's point that the excess (4.0 km, 36.4%) sits below both the 50% and the 8.0 km materiality gate is accepted: no MATERIAL deviation is recorded, no POL-RD-06(b) uplift is available, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d of 0 against 610 completed trips in 90 days establishes no repeat pattern — so no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral either.

No traffic advisory was available (EV-ADVIS-09115-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot exonerate anyone; the chat log carries no rider detour instruction and both waypoint_hint fields are null, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable on this record; the trip record shows no amendment (pickup/dropoff amendment fields and amended_optimal_distance_km all null) and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 have no application.

BILLING INTEGRITY produces no referral: erp_gantries is empty, airport_surcharge is 0.00, there is no charge line without a counterpart, and the fare is METERED and CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0 — POL-RD-09(4) is not engaged.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT: an unimpaired trace across the disputed stretch, or one of the four POL-RD-07(ii) sources — a driver admission, a charged gantry placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, a counterparty admission of the route, or a distance figure the platform derived independently of this trace.
Both parties: the GPS trace is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a).
A single 160-second gap runs from 20:03:10 to 20:05:50, exceeding the 90-second limit, and it falls inside the disputed segment.
EV-GPS-09115 is also admissibility-IMPAIRED, weight 0.6, issue GPS_GAP; I name that discount and issue as POL-GEN-02(3) requires.
Under POL-RD-07(ii), with the trace impaired, a deviation cannot be established on the trace alone and needs one of the four independent corroborating sources.

None exists: EV-CHAT-09115 contains no driver admission of a detour; EV-FARE-09115 charges no erp_gantries (empty array, tolls_erp 0.00); the driver's counterparty statement denies an extra stop or detour request and does not admit the route; and EV-TRIP-09115 actual_distance_km of 15.0 km is identical to gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 15.0 km, so it is a copy of the same measurement, not independent.
The billed distance of 15.0 km is likewise not independent.

The rider's POL-RD-01 arithmetic is 15.0 km trace against 11.0 km optimal, an excess of 4.0 km and 36.36%, but because the trace is impaired and uncorroborated I cannot use it to establish the deviation.
Under POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) the outcome must be ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION and not PARTIAL_REFUND.
My confidence is capped at 0.60 by the impaired trace under POL-GEN-02(2), below the 0.70 floor, which independently triggers POL-RD-10(1).
The disputed SGD 5.80 is held rather than collected or refunded.

If the deviation could be established, the fare arithmetic would be charged_total 26.60 less recomputed_fare 20.831, giving 5.769 rounded up to SGD 5.80; I do not reach that because of the impairment.

The excess is not material under POL-RD-01 (36.4% is below 50% and 4.0 km is below 8.0 km), and EV-DPROF-09115 shows deviation_flags_90d 0 over completed_trips_90d 610, so no POL-RD-06 pattern, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral.
EV-ADVIS-09115-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 cannot exonerate anything.
EV-CHAT-09115 has null waypoint_hint and names no road, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot run.

The human reviewer should obtain an independent record of the missing 160-second stretch or a driver statement that admits the route, because that is what would resolve the escalation.

To the rider: the platform's own trace does record this trip at 15.0 km against a booked optimal of 11.0 km — an excess of 4.0 km, or 36.4% — so your account of the trip is consistent with the instruments and is not treated as mistaken.
But the trace carries a 160-second gap (20:03:10 to 20:05:50) sitting on the very segment where the trip is said to have left the route.

The admissibility pre-pass records that as issue GPS_GAP on EV-GPS-09115, marks the artifact IMPAIRED and gives it weight 0.6, and notes that distance and route-shape claims across that segment require independent corroboration.
Under POL-RD-07(a) a gap of more than 90 seconds inside the disputed segment impairs the trace for policy purposes, so under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on the trace alone.

I checked the four independent sources that clause allows and none is present: the chat log EV-CHAT-09115 carries no driver admission — the driver said only that his navigation display refreshed and he continued toward the destination; the fare breakdown EV-FARE-09115 charges no ERP gantries at all (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00); the driver's statement denies any extra stop or detour request rather than admitting a route; and trip_record.actual_distance_km (15.0 km) is identical to gps_trace.trace_distance_km (15.0 km), so it is a copy of the same measurement, which POL-RD-01 itself describes as a rounded convenience copy, and is expressly not independent corroboration.

POL-RD-07(iii) therefore directs that the claim is not sustained on this record and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because this is a data failure and not a finding for the driver; POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory.

Your advocate's POL-RD-02 arithmetic is itself correct — recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 11.0 + 0.28 x 22.0) x 1.1, the multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-09115, + 0.80 platform fee = 20.831; charged_total 26.60 less 20.831 = 5.769, rounded up to SGD 5.80 — but it can only run once a deviation is established, and POL-RD-07(ii) is what prevents that here.

This is not a MATERIAL deviation on the POL-RD-01 gates (36.4% is below the 50% gate and 4.0 km below the 8.0 km gate), so no POL-RD-06 uplift applies, and POL-RD-06's pattern test returns nothing (deviation_flags_90d 0 against completed_trips_90d 610, a rate of 0.00), so no conduct referral fires.

No exculpatory clause is open to you either: the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-09115-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot run; the chat log contains no rider instruction and both messages carry null waypoint_hints, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable; and POL-RD-05/POL-RD-12 do not apply (no amendment timestamps and a null amended optimal; vehicle_type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL).
Effect: under POL-RD-10 escalation is terminal.

No amount is refunded and no compensation is awarded; the contested SGD 5.80 is held rather than collected or refunded, and the case goes to a human reviewer with the case summary, both advocate briefs and the admissibility report.
Confidence is 0.60: the escalation rests on the impaired trace at weight 0.6, and that is also below the 0.70 platform floor, so POL-RD-10(1) would independently bar a final ruling.

What would resolve this is any artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names — a driver admission in the chat, an ERP gantry placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, a counterparty admission of the route, or a trip-record distance derived independently of this trace — or a repaired trace with the 20:03:10 to 20:05:50 gap closed.

The straight-line reading of 1.35 km across the gap is noted as POL-RD-07(i)'s most driver-favourable measure, but it decides nothing here.
The deciding fact — that the deviation cannot be established — is carried solely by the impaired trace at weight 0.6, so confidence is capped at 0.60.
